name: boot
design: kalimba C5-E5-G5-C6 rising, soft FM bell E6 with a faint C7 sparkle on top

name: listen_start_1
design: rising bloop pair G5->C6, each slides up into its note; dry so the mic opens clean

name: listen_start_2
design: rising bloop pair A5->D6, each slides up into its note; dry so the mic opens clean

name: listen_start_3
design: rising bloop pair G5->D6, each slides up into its note; dry so the mic opens clean

name: listen_stop_1
design: falling bloop pair C6->G5 (each slides down) + band-passed noise whoosh sweeping 3.5->1.4 kHz

name: listen_stop_2
design: falling bloop pair D6->A5 (each slides down) + band-passed noise whoosh sweeping 3.5->1.4 kHz

name: listen_stop_3
design: falling bloop pair D6->G5 (each slides down) + band-passed noise whoosh sweeping 3.5->1.4 kHz

name: latch_start
design: double tap: two quick marimba ticks E6-E6, the second blooms into a rising G5->C6 bloop

name: think_1
gain_notes: target -28 LUFS; kept ~8 dB under the kit
design: 1 soft bubble pop(s) A5, pitch rising inside each pop; very quiet

name: think_2
gain_notes: target -28 LUFS; kept ~8 dB under the kit
design: 2 soft bubble pop(s) E6 C6, pitch rising inside each pop; very quiet

name: think_3

design: 3 soft bubble pop(s) G5 D6 A5, pitch rising inside each pop; very quiet

name: notify
design: three FM bells G5-C6-E6 (ratio 3.5, index decaying) doubled by quiet kalimba for a friendly pluck

name: error_1
design: vowel-coloured "uh-oh" G5->E5 (minor third down), second note droops 1.5 semitones with soft vibrato

name: error_2
design: vowel-coloured "uh-oh" C6->A5 (minor third down), second note droops 1.5 semitones with soft vibrato

name: not_heard_1
design: one soft "hm" on A5 that curls up to D6 at the end like a question

name: not_heard_2

name: connect
design: bright kalimba arpeggio C6-E6-G6-C7 at 60 ms steps with a glassy E7 sparkle

name: disconnect
design: two muted kalimba notes E6->A5, the second sags 30 cents like power running out

name: wake
design: yawn: breathy C5->A5 glide swelling up with growing vibrato, then C7-E7-G7 sparkles

name: tap_1
design: "bip!" short C6 sine blip with a tiny upward scoop

name: tap_2
design: "bwip?" G5->D6 upward swoop

name: tap_3
design: "pik" tight marimba tick E6

name: tap_4
design: "boop" A5->E5 downward glide

name: tap_5
design: "bi-dip" two micro blips C6 then G6

name: tap_6
design: "bwee-oo" D6 up to G6 and back down to E6 with vibrato

name: giggle_1
design: "hehehe" G6-E6-D6-C6-A5 staccato, each syllable scooped and wobbled at 16 Hz

name: giggle_2
design: "hehehe" E6-D6-C6-A5 staccato, each syllable scooped and wobbled at 16 Hz

name: giggle_3
design: "hehehe" D6-C6-A5-G5-E5 staccato, each syllable scooped and wobbled at 16 Hz

name: pet_1
design: purr: 25 Hz pulses of noise at 650 Hz + hum on C5 (heard via harmonics), two breaths, sparkles E7 G7

name: pet_2
design: purr: 23 Hz pulses of noise at 820 Hz + hum on G5 (heard via harmonics), two breaths, sparkles C7 A6

name: dizzy
design: slide whistle G6 -> C5 with a 6.5 Hz wobble and a breath, then a small twangy boing on G5

name: surprise_1
design: "whoop!" fast ease-out slide C5->C6 with a breath, settles with light vibrato

name: surprise_2
design: "whoop!" fast ease-out slide G5->E6 with a breath, settles with light vibrato

name: hello

name: screen_on

name: screen_off

name: setup

name: setup_phone

name: setup_wait
design: soft sonar ping on E6 (repeats every ~1.8 s while joining): a small bloop into a round bell

name: setup_ok
design: small fanfare: kalimba run C5-E5-G5-C6-E6-G6, bell chord C6+E6+G6, sparkles, a last C7 bell

name: setup_fail
design: gentle "uh-oh": two rounded "oh" tones E6 then C6 that sags a little, soft marimba A4 under it

name: menu_open
design: a panel slides in and settles: soft rising air, marimba G5 -> C6, a small round bell on E6

name: menu_close
design: the panel folds away: falling air, marimba E6 -> G5, the second darker
